languages: Blink Dog, understands Sylvan but can't speak it

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Teleport
traits.description: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
